defaults.unsubscribeText: You're receiving this because we thought it was relevant to {{salon_name}}.

messages.title: A red-carpet tan for {{salon_name}}?
messages.preview: The professional solution behind Jimmy Coco's Hollywood tans — a complimentary sample for your booth.
messages.headline: Red-carpet colour, in your booth.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},
I'll keep this short. I look after salon partnerships for Sunless by Jimmy Coco — the professional line from the tanning artist behind a lot of the colour you've seen on red carpets and covers.

Our Malibu professional solution is built around the thing clients notice first: colour that reads warm and believable in daylight — never orange, never flat. It is an undertone-aware professional spray for your booth, with a focused take-home range your clients can buy on the way out.
With spring racing and summer bookings not far off, now is the quiet window to trial it.
Could I send {{salon_name}} a complimentary sample of the Malibu solution and Jimmy's shade guide — no cost, no commitment?
Or just reply “send it” — that is all I need.

messages.title: re: {{salon_name}} + Jimmy Coco
messages.preview: Still happy to post a free sample out before summer.
messages.headline: Still happy to post one out.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},

Floating this back to the top of your inbox. The offer still stands — a free sample of the Malibu professional solution and Jimmy's shade guide, sent to {{salon_name}} so you can trial it on a real client before summer.
Salons tend to switch for the same reason: fewer “it went orange” conversations, and a premium name clients already recognise. Happy to let the sample make the case.
Or a one-word reply is plenty.

messages.title: Two tan revenue lines, one partner
messages.preview: Your booth and your retail shelf, working together.
messages.headline: One partner. Two ways to earn.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},
Jimmy Coco can support two revenue lines inside the same salon:

items: In the booth: Malibu professional solution for premium, believable colour and a service clients can value properly.
On the shelf: a curated take-home range that helps clients maintain their result without using more chair time.

blocks.html: One partner, one visual language and two commercial opportunities — without discounting your service or your brand.
The complimentary sample offer is still open — reply and I will arrange it.

messages.title: Before the spring racing rush
messages.preview: Trial, training and first stock are easier before the peak begins.
messages.headline: Your busy season starts before the bookings do.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},

The best time to change or add a professional tanning line is before the diary becomes crowded. A calm trial gives your team time to assess the colour, learn Jimmy's shade method and decide what belongs in the booth and on the shelf.

items: Trial the professional solution on a real client.
Train the team on shade selection and application.
Choose the opening professional and retail range.
Prepare launch assets before demand peaks.

blocks.html: This is not a discount play. It is a premium service system designed to help {{salon_name}} enter the season prepared and confident.

messages.title: Should I close the file?
messages.preview: Closing this out — but the shade guide is yours to keep.
messages.headline: I'll leave it there.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},
I've reached out a couple of times about getting {{salon_name}} set up with Jimmy Coco before summer and haven't heard back — which is completely fine. I won't keep cluttering your inbox.
I'll close the file for now. If the timing's just off, reply any time and I'll pick it straight back up.
Either way, here's Jimmy's shade guide to keep — it's genuinely useful for any solution you're working with.

messages.title: Welcome to Jimmy Coco — here is what happens next
messages.preview: Three simple steps, and your sample is moving.
messages.headline: Three simple steps from interest to trial.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},
Brilliant — really glad you are in. Here is exactly what happens next:

items: Your sample: reply with the best postal address for {{salon_name}} and I will arrange the Malibu professional solution and Jimmy's shade guide.
A short setup call: once you have seen the colour, we will cover Jimmy's shade method, the pro and take-home ranges and trade terms.
Ready for season: from there we can get the booth stocked and the team confident before demand increases.

blocks.html: No lock-in and no pressure. The sample is yours to judge on your own clients first.
Jimmy's shade guide: view the guide.
